sources.title: DHARMA, Orissa State Museum plates of Mahasivagupta Yayati year 4
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for Sanskrit language, Uḍra place language, village grant, beneficiary genealogy, taxes, officials, water and dry land, and named record makers.

sources.title: DHARMA, Mahulpara plates of Mahasivagupta Dharmaratha year 11
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for royal year, village grant, recipient genealogy, record-office head Netradeva, engraver Sornnanka, and its unusually intimate opening verse.

sources.title: DHARMA, Baragaon plates of the time of Janamejaya year 13
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for resident householders, district people, officers, four village boundaries, exemptions, trees, grass, water, and rents.

sources.title: DHARMA, Balijhari plates of Mahabhavagupta Uddyotakesarin year 4
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for two donated villages, two brother beneficiaries, resident payments, minister Rudradatta, record officer Satamata, and two goldsmith engravers.

sources.title: DHARMA, Brahmesvara temple inscription of Uddyotakesarin year 18
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for the lost-inscription caveat, Chandihara restoration story, queen mother Kolavati, temple dedication, learned poet, women attached to the temple, and mason Raya.

sources.title: DHARMA, Kamalpur plates of the time of Karna year 4
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for Karna year 4, a subordinate Vaisnava donor, Sanskrit text, and its edited opening.

sources.title: DHARMA, Gandhibedha Surya image inscription of the time of Karna
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for a fragmentary image inscription associated with Karna and the severe limits of its preserved text.

sources.title: DHARMA, Nuapatna plates of Mahabhavagupta Janamejaya year 5
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for a Somavamshi copperplate grant, ruler, regnal year, beneficiaries, and administrative formulae.

sources.title: DHARMA, Patna plates of Mahasivagupta Yayati year 8
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for royal titulature, genealogy, grant language, and the distinction between court claims and observed control.

sources.title: DHARMA, Patna plates of Mahasivagupta Yayati year 24
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for a later regnal-year charter, genealogy, named places, fiscal language, and its value and limits for chronology.

sources.title: Odisha Review, History of Odisha in Retrospect
sources.note: Government historical overview checked for Somavamshi rise in South Kosala, movement into coastal Odisha, regional state formation, chronology, and succession by the Eastern Gangas.

sources.title: Utkal University, Socio-Political and Administrative History of Ancient India, Paper XII
sources.note: Official university course, Somavamshi and Ganga political-history units, checked for ruler sequences, Karna, Chodaganga, competing chronology, and the Lingaraja inscription reading.

sources.title: Government of Odisha, Jagatsinghpur District Gazetteer
sources.note: Official district gazetteer checked at PDF pages 36 to 38 (gazetteer pages 19 to 21) for Somavamshi expansion, Karna, Chodaganga, Mukhalingam, Cuttack, Jajpur, and one reconstruction of the transition around 1108 to 1113.

sources.title: Odisha Review, A Glimpse of Odishan History
sources.note: Government historical overview, especially article page 9, checked for Janmejaya, Yayati, Dharmaratha, Uddyotakesarin, regional power, architectural achievements, and broad succession by the Eastern Gangas.

sources.title: Chittaranjan Mishra, Nature of Odishan Economy: From Ancient to Early-Medieval Period
sources.note: Odisha Review, May 2022, pages 58 to 64, especially page 62, checked for bali, bhaga, bhoga, hiranya, land classifications, cultivation, cottage industry, and the need to separate evidence from later examples.

sources.title: Odisha Review, Land Records in Odisha: A Historical Perspective
sources.note: Government historical article checked in its land-records discussion for charter survey, measurement, boundary description, record keeping, and land administration.

sources.title: Studies in People's History, Trade and traders: An exploration into trading communities and their activities in early medieval Odisha
sources.note: Peer-reviewed article checked for inland and maritime routes, merchant groups, market connections, political change, and limits of evidence for individual households.

sources.title: Central Water Commission, History of irrigation development in Orissa
sources.note: Government technical history checked for tanks, wells, irrigation traditions, regional water management, and chronological cautions.

sources.title: Shell Bangle Manufacturing in Coastal Odisha: A Study of Surface Collection at Manikapatana
sources.note: Archaeological paper checked for shell-working debris, bangles, coastal production, port context, long chronology, and dating limits.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism, Mukteswar Temple
sources.note: Official heritage page checked for tenth-century date, torana, sculpture, ascetics, and the carved image of a woman writing a letter.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism, Rajarani Temple
sources.note: Official heritage page checked for eleventh-century date, sandstone, plan, sculpture, and cautious interpretation of incomplete architecture.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism, Lingaraj Temple
sources.note: Official heritage page checked for eleventh-century date, 150 subsidiary shrines, four main halls, detailed plan, carvings of daily chores, Bindusagar, and present worship.

sources.title: IGNCA Archaeological Survey report, Brahmesvara Temple
sources.note: Official monument report checked for 1058 date, Kolavati patronage, plan, sandstone architecture, sculpture, inscriptions, and continuing use.

sources.title: D. B. Mishra, Glimpses of Performing Art Heritage in Orissan Inscriptions
sources.note: Odisha Review, May 2006, pages 22 to 29, checked for epigraphic and sculptural performance evidence, instruments, performers, and the page 25 Ratnagiri-charter discussion of Karpurasri and Mahari-Mahunadevi.

sources.title: Nanda Kishor Swain, The Purusottama Temple of Somavamsi Period at Puri
sources.note: Odisha Review, June-July 2022, page 65 onward, checked for Shaiva royal identity, claimed Vaishnava patronage, absence of a Purusottama temple in known Somavamshi plates, and later legendary chronicles.

sources.title: British Museum, figure of Agni from Orissa
sources.note: Museum catalogue checked for provenance, eleventh- to twelfth-century date, bronze material, size, iconography, water bowl, and rosary.

sources.title: British Museum, leogryph figure from Orissa
sources.note: Museum catalogue checked for Odisha provenance, eleventh- to twelfth-century date, sandstone material, scale, and the dating range across the atlas seam.

sources.title: Shodhganga, Early temples of Orissa from the sixth century to the end of Somavamsi rule
sources.note: Indian national thesis repository record checked for research scope, temple chronology, architecture, patronage, and the end-of-dynasty boundary.

sources.title: Utkal University journal, Career and Achievements of Anantavarman Chodagangadeva
sources.note: University journal article, PDF pages 107 to 109 (journal pages 102 to 104), checked for Mukhalingam 1108, Korni 1112, Karna around 1106 to 1112, competing 1112 or 1114 Lingaraja readings, and annexation reconstructed around 1118.

sources.title: Inscriptions of Orissa, volume 3 part 2
sources.note: Digital scan of an epigraphic corpus checked for Karna, Chodaganga, inscriptions, regional incorporation, and contested dates.

sources.title: DHARMA, Sankhameri plates of Mahabhavagupta Uddyotakesarin year 4
sources.note: Critical digital edition checked for Sanskrit language metadata, charter form, Uddyotakesarin, regnal dating, and the limits of using a formal grant to infer everyday speech or literacy.

sources.title: University of Chicago DSAL, Macdonell A Practical Sanskrit Dictionary
sources.note: Dictionary entry checked for svasti as well-being or success, used to label the card's short English rendering as an author translation rather than an edition translation.
